'''''Guarianthe aurantiaca''''' is a species of [[orchid]]. It is widespread across much of [[Mexico]], south to [[Costa Rica]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite POWO |id=urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:1056444-2 |title=Guarianthe aurantiaca (Bateman ex Lindl.) Dressler & W.E.Higgins |access-date=31 December 2025}}</ref> The [[diploid]] [[chromosome]] number of ''G. aurantiaca'' has been determined as 2''n'' = 40.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Felix |first=Leonardo P. |last2=Guerra |first2=Marcelo |date=June 2010 |title=Variation in chromosome number and the basic number of subfamily Epidendroideae (Orchidaceae) |journal=Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society |volume=163 |issue=2 |pages=234-278 |doi=10.1111/j.1095-8339.2010.01059.x}}</ref>

The phananthrenoids [[orchinol]] and [[loroglossol]] have a [[phytoalexin]] effect and reduce the growth of ''G. aurantiaca'' seedlings.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Hills |first=Katherine A. |last2=Stoessl |first2=Albert |last3=Oliva |first3=Allison P. |last4=Arditti |first4=Joseph |date=September 1984 |title=Effects of Orchinol, Loroglossol, Dehydroorchinol, Batatasin III, and 3,4'- Dihydroxy-5-Methoxydihydrostilbene on Orchid Seedlings |journal=Botanical Gazette |volume=145 |issue=3 |pages=298-301 |jstor=2474721}}</ref>
